policy: PASS means the bound profile passed only its stated check; FAIL means that check detected a violation, not that the whole case failed; REVIEW_REQUIRED means no source-bound executor/context was available. These are not full BR, semantic, or business approvals.
negativeScenarioPolicy: A profile FAIL on a negative scenario whose element matches the declared violated element is an expected negative-target detection candidate; other negative FAILs require review.

ruleCoverage.title: Segment 100 is required exactly once
Companion segments are not duplicated
TPDU Protocol ID is 0x60
Message format identifier is ATL105
Segment Type is 100
Terminal Identifier has valid format
Prompt Code represents transaction and card context
Partial Approval Indicator uses an allowed value
Reserved TPDU destination and source addresses are zero
Information Byte uses a source-defined value
Account Number or identification value is present for the transaction context
Card Discretionary Block Data follows conditional source rules
Encrypted PIN Block Data follows DUKPT representation when PIN applies
Pump/Lane Number is valid when fuel or lane context applies
Fuel Purchase Amount follows the net fuel amount rule
Nonfuel Amount follows the net nonfuel amount rule
Tax Amount follows the total tax amount rule
Cash Amount follows the total cash amount rule
Local Date and Local Time use the source-defined representation when required
eWIC Segment 103 carries bounded WIC and EBT data
Segment 101 is a Data Section 3 companion of Segment 100
Segment Type is 101
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
Odometer, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 8
Vehicle Number, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 10
Job Number, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 10
Driver/Identification Number, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 10
Fleet Employee Number, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 10
License #, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 10
Job ID, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 12
Department #, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 12
Customer Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 12
User ID, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 12 and non-zero
Vehicle ID#, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 8
Fleet Tag format is 3-byte code plus up to 31-byte data payload
Fleet Tag 3-byte code must be one of the 17 codes in the fleet-tag code table
Fleet Tag data payload conforms to the per-code format
Segment 101 appears exactly once per message
Segment Type is 102
Service Level uses an allowed value
Number of Products is 01-10 and zero-padded
A maximum of ten products is allowed in the segment
Product Code is a valid value per Appendix F
Unit of Measure uses an allowed value
Quantity preserves the assumed-decimal-place leading digit
Unit Price preserves the assumed-decimal-place leading digit
Product Amount is present for every product entry
Segment 102 total length does not exceed 381 characters
Segment 103 is a Data Section 3 companion segment usable in any Data Section 3 field slot
Segment Type is 103
Segment Length is 3 or 4 digits; 4 digits is required for EBT-with-eWIC transactions
Clerk ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Voucher ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
WIC Discount Amount uses the positional format Account Type(97) + Amount Type(52) + Currency Code + signed Amount
WIC Discount Amount maximum length is 40 bytes, composed of one or more 20-byte positional blocks
WIC Product Data is bounded to 3,001 bytes and begins with a 4-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 2997
EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264
EBT Program Data contains 1 to 6 Program Data subelements, each bounded to 44 bytes
EBT Program Data subelement TAG must be one of the documented values (50, IT for requests; 51, 52 for responses)
EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT)
Segment 103 appears exactly once per message

EBT Program Data subelement full positional layout: TAG+LEN+ACCOUNT TYPE(98)+AMOUNT TYPE(=TAG)+CURRENCY CODE(840)+AMOUNT DESCRIPTOR(0/C/D)+DETAIL(12-digit amount) for TAG 50/51/52; TAG+LEN+ADDRESS(28)+ZIP(9) for TAG IT

WIC Product Data subelement catalog: EF (Earliest WIC Benefit Expiration Date, 8 bytes), EA (WIC Prescription Balance Information, up to 14 bytes), PS (WIC UPC Exception/Denial or Purchase Information, up to 47 bytes)
Segment Type is 105
Information Byte is required
Terminal Identifier is required
Prompt Code is 990
Totals Date uses a permitted source-defined request code
Hardware Version is required
Software Version is required
Firmware Version is required
Sequence Number is required
Grand Total, Card Label, Card Type Total Count, and Card Type Total Amount are required
A Totals Request contains Data Sections 1 and 3 only; it has no Data Section 2 and no Segment 100
In a Totals Request, Segment 105 is the only data segment and occupies Data Section 3 Field No. 3
In a Totals Request, Element 63 (Number of Segments) is 01
Segment 105 is present in every Totals Request
Segment 108 belongs exclusively to the Loyalty Card Transaction Request; it is not a Financial Transaction Request companion
Segment Type is 108
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
Loyalty Program ID, required, is numeric with maximum length 6
Loyalty Account Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 24
Points to Redeem, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 6
Coupon ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 19
Coupon Amount, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 8
Update Code, when populated, is exactly one alphanumeric character from the documented set A, C, E, I, P, S, T, U
Street Address, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 5
Phone Number, Loyalty, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Expiration Date, when populated, is numeric length 4 in MMYY format; device sends default 1249 when no expiration date is present on the card
Payment Tender Type is required, exactly 2 alphanumeric characters from the documented set AX, CK, CS, DB, DN, DS, EB, EC, FL, GC, JC, MC, PC, PR, VS
Loyalty Track 2 Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 38
Loyalty Information Version, when populated, is numeric length 1 with valid values 1 or 2; defaults to 1 when not sent
Unit of Work, when populated, is numeric with fixed length 19; required on loyalty reversals to match the original purchase
Segment 108 appears exactly once per message
In a Loyalty Card Transaction Request, Element 63 (Number of Segments) counts Segment 100, Segment 108 and the optional Segment 114, so it is 2 or 3 and equals the number of segments present
An Electronic Mail Request contains Data Section 1 (Elements 55 and 63) and Segment 109 as its only segment, in Field No. 3; it has no Segment 100
Data Section 1 contains required Message Format Version Identifier (Element 55) and Number of Segments (Element 63), separated and followed by a Field Separator
Segment Type is fixed value 109
Segment Length is three numeric characters and includes Segment Type and Field Separators
Information Byte is required and one numeric character
Terminal Identifier is required and uses the approved device identifier format
Block Number is required and three numeric characters
Employee Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length four
Password, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length six and must be masked in fixtures
Sequence Number is required and six numeric characters
Local Time, Extract Date, and Extract Time, when populated, are numeric with lengths four, six, and four respectively
Segment 110 originates at the device
Segment Type (Element 85) is fixed value 110
Segment Length (Element 84) is required and identifies the segment's serialized length including Segment Type and Field Separators

MICR Data (Element 122) is required, alphanumeric, maximum 50 bytes, and required on all check transactions; when raw MICR data exceeds 50 bytes, only the first 50 bytes (left to right) are placed here and the remainder is expected in Extended MICR Data (Element 137), whose hosting data segment is not confirmed by the extracted Segment 110 table

Driver's License (Element 123) is conditional, alphanumeric, maximum 40 bytes, and required on all manually entered check transactions; the machine-testable trigger that distinguishes a manually entered check transaction from a MICR-read one is not defined in the extracted Segment 110 table

Date of Birth (Element 125) is conditional, numeric, fixed 8 digits (MMDDYYYY); the extracted Segment 110 table marks it conditional but states no explicit trigger separate from the Driver's License/State Code identification bundle
Check Type (Element 126) is required, alphanumeric, fixed 1 character, and must be one of the documented codes: P (Personal) or C (Company)
Check Number (Element 127) is conditional, alphanumeric, maximum 8 bytes, and required for manually keyed check data; it shares the same undefined manually-entered trigger as Driver's License
Customer Phone Number (Element 128) is optional, numeric, maximum 10 digits
Customer Last Name (Element 129) is optional, alphanumeric, maximum 24 bytes
Check Issue Date (Element 130) is optional, numeric, fixed 8 digits (MMDDYYYY)

Alternate MICR IND, documented in Section 12.9 as Segment 110 field 12 using element number 239, is optional, fixed 1 byte, and its only documented value is 'Y' (Alternate/RAW TOAD MICR format is being sent); this element number is separately defined in the Chapter 13 master element catalog as 'Enhanced Fleet Data' (999 bytes, used by Segment 145). Per SME decision (2026-09-26), both usages are modeled as distinct, segment-scoped entities (element 239 @ Segment 110 vs. element 239 @ Segment 145); this rule intentionally remains REVIEW_REQUIRED by design, not due to a gap

Two MICR encodings are documented in narrative text: Full MICR Line TAC format (example T999999999A999999999999999999C999999) and Full MICR Line RAW TOAD format (symbol substitution using T, O, A, D); Alternate MICR IND = 'Y' signals RAW TOAD/ALB1 format, but no machine-checkable grammar beyond the example and the 50-byte length limit is given

An ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request carries Segment 100, Segment 110 (Field No. 4) and Segment 111 (Field No. 5), plus the conditional Segment 113 (Field No. 6) and no other segment; Element 63 is therefore 3 or 4 and equals the number of segments present
Segment Type is 112
Segment Length identifies the segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators
Segment 112 appears only at the end of a Financial Transaction response
Additional Information Indicator (Element 116) identifies the type of additional information being transmitted
Additional Information Length (Element 117) identifies the length of the following Additional Information (Element 118)
Additional Information (Element 118) is variable length and carries the value identified by its paired Indicator/Length
Segment 113 belongs exclusively to the ECA/TeleCheck® Service Transaction Request; it is not a Financial Transaction Request companion
Segment Type is 113
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
ECA/TeleCheck® Clerk ID, required, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6
ECA/TeleCheck® Product Code, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 6 and has no documented enumeration (free-form, merchant/risk-control defined)
ECA/TeleCheck® Phone Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
ECA/TeleCheck® Trace ID, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 22; required on Void transaction requests
Merchant Trace ID, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 25
Denial Record Number, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 7; used to reference a declined ECA/TeleCheck® transaction on Denial Record receipts
Extended MICR Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 65; must supplement MICR Data (Element 122) in Segment 110 when raw MICR data exceeds 50 bytes
Segment 113 appears at most once per message

Segment 114 is exclusive to the Loyalty Card Transaction Request's Data Section 3; it is not documented as a companion in the Financial Transaction Request (11.1.1), ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Request (11.3.1), or CA Public Key File Load Request (11.9.1) Data Section 3 lists
Segment Type is fixed value 114
Segment Length is 4 digits, valid values 0001-1010, representing the segment content length including Segment Type's length and Field Separators
SKU Data (Element 149) is required, alphanumeric, with a maximum length of 1000 characters, and identifies the bar code SKU data
Segment 114 may repeat within a single message, once per scanned bar code SKU; it is not limited to zero-or-one occurrence
Segment 115 is response-only: it appears only in the Financial Transaction Response and EMV Financial Transaction Response, never in any Request message
Segment Type is fixed value 115
Segment Length is 4 digits, one of exactly seven segments across the specification requiring a 4-digit Segment Length (103, 114, 115, 118, 120, 130, 131)

Print Data (Element 152) is required and identifies the print data being transmitted to the device; per Section 12.14's note this field carries the terms & conditions text for Blackhawk phone activation and recharge receipts

Segment 116 (TransArmor Load Data Segment) is used for Key and Key ID Load in TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization processing; confirmed via the Element 63 (Number of Segments) and Element 85 (Segment Type) processing-rule text and valid-codes tables
Segment Type (Element 85) is fixed value 116 and is explicitly stated as Required for the TransArmor PKI Encryption and Tokenization Load Request

Segment Length (Element 84) is present as Segment 116 field 2, following the universal Chapter 12 data-segment convention observed in every other defined segment (100 through 156); not independently confirmed by a Segment 116-specific table because Section 12.15 is a stub

The complete field-by-field layout of Segment 116 beyond Segment Type and Segment Length (i.e., what occupies the remainder of its 50-byte maximum) is not available in the current ATL105 extract; Sections 12.15 and 11.7.5 are both stub references to the external TransArmor specification-updates document

Section 11.4.1.2 labels 'Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request' as '(Data Segment No. 116)'; this is a source inconsistency. The authoritative Element 85 Segment Type valid-codes table and Section 12.17 both confirm that segment is actually Data Segment No. 119 ('Totals with Proprietary Data Load Data Segment'). Segment 116 is reserved exclusively for the TransArmor Load Data Segment; do not use the Section 11.4.1.2 label as evidence of Segment 116 content

Proprietary Data Load Segment requests or carries Customer Specific Proprietary data for loading (host-to-device push: Dynamic Card Table, Custom Receipt Text, Host Discounts) or capturing (device-to-host push: Site Configuration, Fuel Volume) at the BUYPASS FEP; functionally similar to Electronic Mail
Segment 118 originates at the device
Segment Type (Element 85) is fixed value 118, Required, field 1
Segment Length (Element 84) is Required, field 2, and is 4 numeric digits (unlike the 3-digit Segment Length used by most other segments), including the Segment Type's length and Field Separators
Sequence Number (Element 86) is Required, field 3, 6 digits, and identifies the unique transaction sequence number for the life of the transaction

Information Byte (Element 44) is Required, field 4, 1 character, and indicates whether the request is a single-message or multimessage request; the complete value catalog is not shown in this workspace's source
Terminal Identifier (Element 102) is Required, field 5, 13 characters, identifying the device by Device Type, State Code, BUYPASS Merchant Number, and Device Number

Prompt Code (Element 78) is Required, field 6, 3 digits, and must be one of the five documented values: 901 (Custom receipt text), 902 (Dynamic card table), 903 (Site configuration data), 904 (Host discount data), 905 (Fuel volume data), per Appendix E's Valid Card Type Codes Used in Special Transaction Prompt Codes

Prompt Code, Pending (Element 182) is Required, field 7, 4 digits, and must be one of the documented values: 0901 (Custom Receipt Text Data), 0902 (Proprietary Data Load), 0904 (Host Discount Data), 0981 (Electronic Mail)

Device Card Table Version (Element 176) is Required, field 8, 35 numeric digits: seven 5-digit version values strung together for the Card Table Master ID, BIN table, RULES table, RESTRICTIONS table, SAF table, PROMPT table, and PRODUCT table versions; a value beginning with 99999 indicates no card table is used at the location

Card Table Load Version (Element 177) is Required, field 9, 35 numeric digits, representing the versions of the Card Table components currently being loaded; sourced from the Host and echoed back in each subsequent block request

Card Table Type (Element 174) is Required, field 10, 4 digits, identifying the specific table type this segment addresses, sourced from the Host and echoed back; valid values are 0001 (BIN Table), 0002 (RULES Table), 0003 (RESTRICTIONS Table), 0004 (SAF Table), 0005 (PROMPT Table), 0006 (PRODUCT Table)
Load Control Key (Element 178) is Required, field 11, 60 characters, sourced from the Host and echoed back in each subsequent block request
Host Discount Timestamp (Element 179) is Required, field 12, 12 digits, format CCYYMMDDHHMM, sourced from the Host

Block Number (Element 11) is Conditional, field 13, 3 digits, identifying the specific block being sent by device or Host; the Host uses this value to determine the next block to send, and it is echoed back in the subsequent block request

When Prompt Code is 901 (Custom Receipt Text Data, response only), fields 14-20 are: Start Date (165, 8, CCYYMMDD), Start Time (166, 4, HHMM), End Date (165, 8), End Time (166, 4), Number of Receipt Text Lines (168, 2), then a repeated Receipt Text Data Length (169, 2) / Receipt Text Data (170, 20) block for a total variable length up to 220 bytes; fields are not Field-Separated
When Prompt Code is 902 (Dynamic Card Table Data, response only), field 14 is Card Table Data (175, max 3,600 bytes, length determined by the Segment Length in field 2)
When Prompt Code is 903 (Site Configuration Data, request only), field 14 is Site Configuration Data (180, max 3,600 bytes, Source: Vendor); a Field Separator follows field 14

When Prompt Code is 904 (Host Discount Data, response only), fields 14-27 are: Host Discount Timestamp (179, 12), Number of Discounts (171, 2), then a repeated block of Start Date (165,8), Start Time (166,4), End Date (165,8), End Time (166,4), BUYPASS Card Type (173,4), Card BIN Range Beginning (183,12), Card BIN Range Ending (184,12), Product Code (77,3), Product Discount Amount (172,5), Product Code (77,3), Discount Quantity Limit (185,3), Discount Program Description (186,15), for a total variable length not to exceed 3,600 bytes
When Prompt Code is 905 (Fuel Volume Data, request only), field 14 is Fuel Volume Data (201, max 3,600 bytes, Source: Vendor); a Field Separator follows field 14
Totals-with-proprietary-load request contains Data Sections 1 and 3 but not Data Section 2
Segment 119 appears in Field No. 3 of Data Section No. 3
Segment Type is fixed value 119
Segment Length is required and includes Segment Type and Field Separators
Information Byte is required
Terminal Identifier is required
Prompt Code is fixed value 990
Employee Number is conditional
Password is conditional
Totals Date is required
Hardware Version is required
Software Version is required
Firmware Version is required
Sequence Number is required
Device Card Table Version is required
Host Discount Timestamp is required and uses CCYYMMDDHHMM
Currency Code is optional
Grand Total is required
Card Label is required for each card bucket
Card Type Total Count is required for each card bucket
Card Type Total Amount is required for each card bucket
Card bucket fields 17-19 repeat up to 20 times in documented order
In a Totals with Proprietary Data Load Request, Element 63 (Number of Segments) is 01, so Segment 119 is the only data segment
Segment Type is 120
Segment Length is present, exactly 4 digits (zero-padded), and equals the segment's actual encoded length including the Segment Type field and Field Separators
Print Data is required and must be present whenever Segment 120 is included
Segment 120 is the final segment of the Data Section 3 companion sequence in a Financial Transaction Response / EMV Financial Transaction Response
Segment Type is fixed value 123 (Element 85), Device-sourced
Segment 123 maximum length is 186 alphanumeric characters; originates at the Device
Token PAN Suffix (Element 197, 4 chars, Conditional, Issuer/Authorizer-sourced) — the last 4 digits of the cardholder PAN — is returned in the response only if supplied by the authorizer
CAVV, Revised Format (Element 195, 20 chars, Optional, Device-sourced) identifies Verified By Visa data with an Authentication Tracking Number (ATN) replacing XID
Cryptogram Token Data (Element 202) length is 28 or 56 bytes — Block A alone, or Block A and B combined

SafeKey Data (Element 203, 58 chars) is composed of a fixed 'SK' indicator (2 bytes), AEVV (28 bytes), and AESK Transaction Identifier (28 bytes); unused 28-byte portions must be space-filled rather than omitted
TAVV Cryptogram (Element 237, 28 bytes, base64 alphabet a-z/A-Z/0-9/+/=// ) may only be populated by the merchant during the transaction request, not the response
Segment Type is fixed value 130
Segment Length is 4 digits, one of exactly seven segments across the specification requiring a 4-digit Segment Length (103, 114, 115, 118, 120, 130, 131)

CA Public Key File Checksum (Element 187), when populated, identifies the checksum received in the last CA Public Key download currently in use at host and device; Optional in the request, sourced Device/Host
EMV Card Sequence Number (Element 188), when populated, identifies the sequence number of the EMV card; Conditional, sourced Device
EMV Chip Data Length (Element 189) is required and identifies the length of the following EMV Chip Data field; valid values 000-999
EMV Chip Data (Element 190) is required, contains TLV-encoded BCD-packed/hex chip data, and must begin with a valid three-digit length consistent with the following encoded chip data
EMV chip values such as authorized amount, transaction type, currency, and terminal country shall agree with the Segment 100 transaction context
Tag 9F26 (Application Cryptogram) authenticity verification is explicitly out of scope for AI/synthetic test generation; it requires a certified EMV kernel or HSM
The EMV Additional Information Section (fields 7-9: Indicator, Length, Information) repeats per EMV Additional Information Indicator for a maximum total length of 2,000 bytes

A CA Public Key file (CA_KEYS) must use the correct file name, version, comma-separated records, and CRLF termination; each record must contain valid expiry date, SHA-1 hash indicator, RSA algorithm indicator, RID, index, modulus, exponent, and checksum fields
The EMV Financial Transaction Request Data Section 3 occupies Field Nos. 4-8 (five slots), so Segment 130 plus at most four companion segments may be present

Appendix T Table ID 001 (EMV Table Data) carries exactly EMVYES or EMVNOT, length 6, sent only in an EMV Transaction request; if returned in an authorization response the device echoes it on any subsequent advice or batch upload request
Appendix T Table ID 002 (Card Authentication Results Code, CARC) has Maximum Length 1 and carries the CARC value returned by Visa in Bit No. 44.8 of the response

Section 12.21 states Segment 131 'always appears in Field No. 4 in Data Section No. 3', but the EMV Financial Transaction Response's own layout table places it at Field No. 17/18/19/20 of Data Section No. 2 (following Segments 112, 115, and 120) — these two placement statements are contradictory
Segment Type is fixed value 131, sourced at the Host (contrast Segment 130's device-sourced Segment Type)
Segment Length is 4 digits, one of exactly seven segments across the specification requiring a 4-digit Segment Length (103, 114, 115, 118, 120, 130, 131)

EMV Chip Data Length (Element 189) and EMV Chip Data (Element 190) are required, mirroring Segment 130's fields, but the field table lists their Source as 'Device' even though Segment 131 as a whole originates at BUYPASS

The EMV Additional Information Section (fields 6-8: Indicator, Length, Information) repeats per EMV Additional Information Indicator for a maximum total length of 2,800 bytes — a DIFFERENT cap than Segment 130's 2,000-byte limit for the structurally identical section
Segment Type is fixed value 132, sourced at the Device
Segment Length is 3 digits (not 4 — Segment 132 is NOT one of the seven 4-digit-length segments)
Sequence Number (Element 86) is required, 6 digits; a limited range (100000-199999) applies ONLY when using the Multithreaded Dial Protocol Communications header for a CAPK File Load
Terminal Identifier (Element 102) is required, 13 characters; for EMV, the first two characters (Device Type) must be '+*' regardless of the actual device type
Load Type (Element 48) is required, fixed value 'K' (indicates Public Key information is requested)
Hardware Version (Element 43), Software Version (Element 96), and Firmware Version (Element 39) are all required device-version identifiers
CA Public Key File Checksum (Element 187) is required in Segment 132, identifying the checksum currently in use — a THIRD segment (after 130 request, 131 response) referencing this same element

Block Number (Element 11) is required, 3 digits, identifying the specific data block requested by a device or sent by the host — implying a multi-block CA key file transfer protocol not fully detailed in this section
Segment Type is fixed value 134, Segment Length is 4 digits

Settlement Type (Element 198) is required, 1 character, valid values D (Dual message), S (Single message), X (Non-traditional Signature Debit — availability must be confirmed with First Data Project/Relationship Manager)
Signature Required (Element 199) is required, 1 character, valid values T (required), F (not required), Space (device software logic determines)
Receipt Card Description (Element 200) is required, 10 characters, left-justified and space-filled (e.g., 'STAR      ')
Segment Type is fixed value 135, sourced at the Device

Segment Length Indicator is 3 digits, identifies the segment's length including Segment Type's length only (NOT explicitly including Field Separators, unlike most other segments' Segment Length description)
Moneris Data (Element 213) is required, max 100 characters, in <tag><len><data> TLV-like format; full layout documented in Appendix V (Moneris Data layouts)
Segment Type is fixed value 136, sourced at the Device (as documented — despite this being a Response segment, the field table lists Source: Device for both Segment Type and Segment Length)
Segment Length Indicator is 3 digits, identifies the segment's length including Segment Type's length
Moneris Data (Element 213) is required, max 100 characters, in <tag><len><data> format; full layout documented in Appendix V (Moneris Data layouts)
Segment Type is fixed value 139, Segment Length is 3 digits, both sourced at the Device

Terminal Identifier (Element 102), SPDH Header (Element 206), Moneris Terminal Identifier (Element 207), Moneris Merchant ID (Element 208), Batch Number (Element 214), and Language Indicator (Element 215) are all required, Device-sourced
Segment 140 consists of a reiteration of the first 6 fields in the Segment 139 request, followed by a text response from Moneris, followed by the total of all debit transactions for this batch

Segment Type fixed 140, Segment Length 3 digits, both Device-sourced; fields 3 (Terminal Identifier), 5 (Moneris Terminal Identifier), 6 (Moneris Merchant ID) are Device-sourced echoes, while fields 4 (SPDH Header), 7 (Batch Number), 8-14 (Response Display, Number/Dollar totals) are Moneris-sourced
Debit Dollar Value (218), Credit Dollar Value (220), and Corrections Dollar Value (222) use format +/-9(16)v99 (signed, up to 16 integer digits, 2 implied decimal digits)

Segment Type fixed 141, Segment Length 3 digits, both Device-sourced; all 14 fields (Terminal Identifier, SPDH Header, Moneris Terminal/Merchant ID, Batch Number, Language Indicator, Number/Dollar totals for debits/credits/corrections) are Device-sourced
Segment 142 consists of a reiteration of the first 6 fields in the Segment 141 request, followed by a text response from Moneris
Segment Type and Segment Length are Host-sourced (contrast Segment 140's Device-sourced Segment Type/Length, and Segment 141's fully-Device-sourced request)

Terminal Identifier, Moneris Terminal Identifier, Moneris Merchant ID are Device-sourced echoes; SPDH Header, Batch Number, Response Display are Moneris-sourced; MAC (Element 210, 16 characters) is Moneris-sourced and validates the response at the terminal
Segment Type is fixed value 143, Segment Length identifies the segment's length including Segment Type's length and Field Separators, both Device-sourced, each followed by a Field Separator
Number of Products (Element 62) is required, 2 digits, and should match the number of products from the Product Code Data Segment

Tax by Product Data repeats per product for a maximum of 10 products, total variable length up to 360 bytes; each product entry contains Product Code (77) plus up to 3 tax sub-entries (Inclusive/Exclusive flag, Tax Type, Tax Amount)
Inclusive/Exclusive flag values: 'I' (inclusive to the product amount), 'E' (exclusive), 'N' (this tax not applicable — tax type and amount fields are OMITTED entirely, not merely blank)
Tax Type is one of GST/HST/PST for Canadian transactions; a product can have between 0 and 3 of these taxes specified
A merchant may end a product's tax entry early (before 3 taxes) by using a Field Separator after the last reported tax entry instead of the '\' delimiter

Segment 145 carries fleet data for enhanced fleet offerings (Wex OTR, Comdata, Voyager EMV, Visa Fleet 2.0, MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV); it may hold multiple TLV-encoded sub-segments (sub-segment type, sub-segment length, sub-segment value)
Segment Type is fixed value 145, Segment Length includes Segment Type's length; both Device-sourced

Enhanced Fleet Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, containing one or more sub-segments in <tag><len><data> format, cataloged as: Table 001 (Request Flags, incl. Commercial/Retail Flag), Table 002 (Non-Fuel Product Data, product-category-coded, '|'-delimited repeating), Table 004 (Prompt Data, authorizer-specific prompt tokens, '|'-delimited repeating), Table 006 (Money Code Payee Name), Table 007 (Money Code Check Number, required for all Money Code transactions), Table 008 (Cash Advance Limit)

Table 002 (Non-Fuel Product Data) product categories are authorizer-specific; a documented list applies to WEX OTR transactions (e.g., ADD, ANFR, BRAK, ... WWFL); other authorizers' category lists are not enumerated in this section

Table 004 (Prompt Data) prompt tokens are authorizer-specific and independently cataloged for Voyager EMV (DF-tag-based), Visa Fleet 2.0, Comdata, WEX OTR, and Conexxus (numeric prompt codes, used by MasterCard Enhanced Fleet EMV); full enumeration of all prompt-token tables is out of scope for this rule catalog pass
Segment Type fixed 146, Segment Length includes Segment Type's length; both Device-sourced (despite this being a response segment, mirroring the sourcing pattern already flagged for Segments 131/136)

Enhanced Fleet Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, cataloged as: Table 001 (Response Flags, incl. Settlement Indicator: CP/DB/DF/RC/RF/FN), Table 002 (Non-Fuel Product Limits, NOT present in Comdata responses), Table 003 (Fuel Product Limits, using Appendix F product codes), Table 004 (Prompt Formats, using documented edit masks), Table 005 (Customer Information: name/city/state/account code), Table 010 (Additional Response Data: FNAM/LNAM/ATHN/ACCT/DMSG)

Table 004 (Prompt Formats) uses a documented edit-mask grammar: '?' (re-prompt), 'A'/'B' (alphanumeric, treated identically since 2015-01-02), 'N' (numeric only), 'I' (free format), 'O' (optional response), 'Z' (capture but don't resend), 'T' (data type N=Number/S=String), 'Mn'/'Xn' (min/max), 'Vn' (exact match), 'Pn' (pattern match using @ /# /* /literal)
Table 003 (Fuel Product Limits) uses standard product codes from ATL105 Appendix F (Valid Payment Systems Product Codes) — unlike Table 002's non-fuel category codes
Segment Type fixed 148, Segment Length includes Segment Type's length; both Host-sourced

Available Product Information (Element 240) is a fixed-format 17-character sub-structure: Restriction Code (2-3 AN, fuel product group codes 00/01/06/07/08/10/11/12/13), '=' filler, Restriction Code Amount (1-5 AN), ',' filler, Restriction Code Quantity (1-5 AN), space filler, Restriction Code Unit of Measure (1 AN)
Segment Type fixed 149, Segment Length 3 digits, Terminal Identifier (var.), Price Data (var., pipe-delimited tag:value pairs e.g. 'CASS:03.00') all Device-sourced
Segment Type fixed 150, Segment Length 3 digits, Terminal Identifier (echo), Decline Code (Element 26, 2 characters, indicates success or failure); all Device-sourced
Segment 151 can appear in ANY field slot of Data Section No. 3 (not a fixed position), originates at the device
Segment Type fixed 151, sourced at Host (despite the segment overall 'originating at the device' per the opening statement) — a sourcing inconsistency

Segment Length is 4 digits (not 3), max 2300 characters; Market Basket Data (unnumbered element) consists of one DV dataset followed by up to 10 PI datasets, with full format defined in a separate 'Buypass Incomm Market Basket Data format' document
Segment Type fixed 152, Segment Length 4 digits, both Host-sourced
Market Basket Data consists of one DV dataset, up to 10 PI datasets, AND up to 10 PU datasets — one more dataset type than the request (Segment 151, which has no PU datasets)
Segment 153 contains Network Token Data for the transaction; may hold multiple TLV-encoded sub-segments (standard sub-segment type, length, value)
Segment Type fixed 153, Segment Length 3 digits (includes Segment Type's length), both Device-sourced

Network Token Data (Element 239) is required, max 999 characters, cataloged as 6 fixed sub-tables: 001 (Network Token, 013-018 bytes), 002 (Expiration Date, fixed 004), 003 (Provisional Fee Indicator, fixed 001), 004 (Input Indicator, fixed 001), 005 (Eligible Indicator, fixed 001), 006 (PAN Indicator, fixed 001)
Card Status (Table 004) valid values: A (New Acct# & Exp Date), E (New Exp Date), Q (Contact Cardholder), C (Closed), U (Unknown Card)
Account Updater Result Code (Table 006) is a fixed 6-character code from a documented enumeration (VAU001 through VAU016, non-contiguous — VAU015 absent), applicable only to Visa
EV Transaction Indicator (Table 01) is mandatory for an EV transaction and must be 'Y'; if the EV segment is sent without this indicator set to 'Y', BUYPASS will decline the transaction
Time-based sub-tables (02 Total Time Plugged In, 03 Total Charging Time, 04 Start Time of Charge, 05 Finish Time of Charge) all use fixed 6-character hhmmss format, hh 00-99, mm/ss 00-59
Charging Reason Code (Table 07) uses a documented Visa-specific enumeration (010-023, 100, 200); other card networks' valid values are not documented here
Connector Type (Table 12) uses a documented Visa-defined enumeration (001-003, 100-103, 200)

Additional numeric measurement sub-tables exist: 06 Charging Power Output Capacity (kW), 08 Estimated KM/Miles Added, 09 Carbon Footprint (CO2e grams), 10 Estimated Vehicle KM/Miles Available, 11 Maximum Power Dispensed — all variable-length numeric fields with documented max lengths
Segment 157 does not allow any product codes above '899' except for '955' (Cash Back); if any other code above 899 is present, the transaction will be declined
Fuel products must always be the first products in the segment; a maximum of ten products is allowed

The total of Adjusted Product Amounts in the segment must equal the total of Element 41 (Fuel Purchase Amount) + Element 58 (Nonfuel Amount) + Element 99 (Tax Amount) + Element 17 (Cash Amount) in Segment 100
Tax, discount, and coupon amounts are already accounted for in the individual Adjusted Product Amounts; separate tax/discount/coupon product codes must NOT be included in the segment
Multi-fuel support: BUYPASS can accept transactions with multiple Fuel Type Codes in one transaction (e.g., Diesel + DEF + Reefer); the primary fuel must be the very first product code in the segment

Segment Type fixed 157, Segment Length 3 digits, Service Level (Element 87), Number of Products (Element 62, 2 digits), then per-product: Product Code (77, max 3 including 899-cap/955-exception), Unit of Measure (106), Quantity (81, 9 digits, must encode assumed decimal places as whole digits, e.g. 0.05 with 2 decimals = '205'), Unit Price (107, 9 digits, same decimal-encoding rule), Product Amount (76, 12 digits)

Segment DL1 uses NO Field Separators; instead it is self-delimited by a Data Type Indicator ('#', field 1) and an End-of-Data Indicator ('~', last field) — a distinct delimiting convention from the numbered segments (85/84 Segment Type/Length pair)
Merchant Name(53,24), Store Number(98,16), Address Line 1(3,24), Address Line 2(4,21), Merchant Phone Number(54,13) are all required, Host-sourced fixed-length fields
Number of Card Types (Element 59) identifies how many times field 8 (Card Type) repeats — Card Type may repeat 01-99 times

Each repeated Card Type (Element 14) must be a valid Appendix E 'Card Type Code Used in the Table Load Response': an accepted card type or a device feature code (for example 127, 148, 150, 162-168, 171, 173, 174); feature codes are never used in Prompt Codes
Address Line 2 (Element 4, 21 characters) is positional: positions 1-12 city, 13 space, 14-15 alphabetic State Code (Appendix D), 16 space, 17-21 ZIP Code

Merchant Phone Number (Element 54) is 13 characters in the form (nnn)nnn-nnnn; Store Number (Element 98) is numeric in the range 0000000000000001-9999999999999999 and, when masked with asterisks, is neither displayed nor printed

Table Load Response block order is ')' + DL1, then DL2 (Conditional), then DL3 (Conditional), then End-of-Load Indicator '*' (Element 35); when DL1 carries Card Type 173, DL6 (Data Block No. 4) follows and the load ends with '*'. For TCP/IP the Start-of-Data Block Indicator appears only before Data Block No. 1
Segment DL2 maximum length is 69 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '!' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)

Dial String Type is fixed value 1; Primary Phone Number block (fields 3-7: Redial Count, Access Code [conditional], Pause Indicator [conditional, fixed 'B'], Phone Number, Dial String Terminator fixed 'A') is required
Redial Count (Element 82) is one digit with valid values 1-3 in both the primary and the secondary block

Phone Number (Element 75) is numeric, variable length up to 18 digits; Dial String Type (Element 28) is fixed '1' (transaction dial strings); Dial String Terminator (Element 27) is 'A' after the first dial string and 'F' after the second
Segment DL3 maximum length is 23 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed ':' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
Day of the Week(25,1), Current Date(21,6), Current Time(22,4), Cut Time(23,4) are all required and Host-sourced
Password (Element 65, 6 characters) is the only Device-sourced field in this segment, identifying the end-of-day function's password — every other field in Segment DL3 is Host-sourced

Day of the Week (Element 25) is one digit 0-6 (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday); Current Date (Element 21) is MMDDYY; Current Time (Element 22) and Cut Time (Element 23) are HHMM; Current Time includes time-zone and daylight-saving adjustment
Password (Element 65) is numeric, variable length up to six digits, right-aligned and space-filled when shorter than six, and is matched against the password in the merchant's BUYPASS profile
Segment DL4 maximum length is 52 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '@' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)

New Software Version(57,8), Software Terminal Record ID(95,13), Software Load Phone Number(91,18), Software Load Request Date(92,6), Software Load Request Time(93,4), Software Load Type(94,1) are all required, Host-sourced

New Software Version (57) and Software Terminal Record ID (95) are fixed-length AN 8 and AN 13; Software Load Phone Number (91) is AN up to 18; Software Load Request Date (92) is MMDDYY; Software Load Request Time (93) is HHMM; Software Load Type (94) is 'F' (full application load) or 'P' (partial application load)
Segment DL5 maximum length is 64 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '$' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)

Segment DL5 is structurally identical to Segment DL4 except field 4 is Software Load IP/URL Address (Element 114, 30 characters) instead of DL4's Software Load Phone Number (Element 91, 18 characters)

Software Load IP/URL Address (Element 114) is AN fixed length 30; New Software Version (57) AN 8, Software Terminal Record ID (95) AN 13, Request Date (92) MMDDYY, Request Time (93) HHMM, Software Load Type (94) 'F' or 'P' follow the same rules as in DL4
Segment DL6 maximum length is 9 alphanumeric characters; originates at BUYPASS (Host); Data Type Indicator fixed '\' (field 1), End-of-Data Indicator fixed '~' (last field)
Start Time and End Time both use Element 166 and format HHMM, defining the window during which store-and-forward processing is blocked
Start Time and End Time (Element 166) are numeric, fixed length four digits HHMM, valid values 0000-2359

Segment DL6 is Data Block No. 4 of the Table Load Response: it follows the End-of-Load Indicator '*' that closes Data Block No. 3 and is itself followed by an End-of-Load Indicator '*'; it is sent only on a Table Load Response

Segment DL7 is identified by the special character '^' (Data Type Indicator, Element 24) but, UNLIKE Segments DL1-DL6, does NOT use an End-of-Data Indicator; instead it uses a Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) to frame the segment, matching the pattern used by numbered segments (100-157) rather than the DL1-DL6 marker convention

Segment Length Indicator (Element 84) for Segment DL7 is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length — a distinct counting convention from most numbered segments, which INCLUDE the Segment Type's length in their Segment Length
Download Data (Element 232, max 100 characters) is required, in <tag><len><data> format, with detailed layout defined in Appendix W (Download Data Layout)

Each Download Data entry is Table ID (n3) + Table Length (n3) + Table Data; Appendix W defines Table ID 001 Site Language (Table Length 003, ISO 639-2 language code of the terminal) and Table ID 002 Postal Code (Table Length 013, international postal code of the transmitting device)
Download Data (Element 232) is alphanumeric, variable length up to 100 bytes, and holds 'all or some of the Download Data'

The DL7 Segment Length (Element 84) is three digits — DL7 is not one of the seven segments allowed a four-digit Segment Length — and must equal the length of the segment content after the Data Type Indicator

Data Type Indicator is fixed value '%' (Element 24); Segment Length Indicator (Element 84, 3 digits) is EXCLUSIVE of the Data Type Indicator's length, same hybrid framing convention as Segment DL7 (no End-of-Data Indicator)

Floor Limit Data repeats per RID, for a maximum of 24 RIDs, total variable length up to 624 bytes; each repetition contains RID (233,10, Host-sourced), Stand-in Indicator (234,1, Host-sourced), Floor Limit (235,12, Host-sourced, maximum allowable stand-in value), BUYPASS RID Card Type (236,3, Host-sourced)

RID (Element 233) is AN fixed 10 and must be a valid EMV Registered Application Provider identifier; Stand-in Indicator (Element 234) is N1 with values 1 (No Stand-in), 2 (Domestic only Stand-in), 3 (Domestic & Foreign Stand-in); Floor Limit (Element 235) is N fixed 12, 000000000000-999999999999; BUYPASS RID Card Type (Element 236) is AN fixed 3
The DL8 Segment Length (Element 84) is three digits and must describe a whole number (1-24) of 26-byte Floor Limit Data groups after the Data Type Indicator
